content.rendered: Archer Glen Picture Day is a week away on  Friday, October 4th. Be sure to send your child’s picture packet to school anytime next week or on Picture Day. They will need to have their packet with them when they go to the photographers. Picture packets are needed even if payment was done online. Extra picture packets are available in the front office.
